description: PAID ($0.0027 USDC via x402). A US-listed company's latest SEC filings from EDGAR, by ticker (AAPL, BRK-B) or CIK: newest first, each with form type, filing and report date, accession number, description, an 8-K's item codes (2.02 results, 5.02 officer changes…) and a direct link to the document on sec.gov — plus the company's name, CIK, tickers, exchanges and industry. Filter by form types (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 4, DEF 14A…). An unknown ticker answers 404 and is not charged. Public-domain data, not investment advice. Without payment this returns the 402 challenge; the fiatdock-mcp npm package pays automatically. Any answer the tool cannot produce is >= 400 and is NOT charged.

forms.description: Only these form types (e.g. 10-K,10-Q,8-K,4,DEF 14A). Omit for all

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization on Base USDC). OMIT it on the first call: the 402 you get back carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate` — the exact envelope to fill in — plus the price and the EIP-712 domain. Send it on the second call to complete the purchase; it is forwarded as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, never as body data. Nothing is charged for the 402 itself, and a call that fails after payment settles nothing.

ticker.description: Stock ticker (AAPL, MSFT, BRK-B) or a CIK number. Omit the whole body to get the published example (AAPL)
